description: Replaces one standard line of the participant pages with your own wording, for example the hint above the required fields or a standard line of the thank-you text. Take it when a fixed line does not fit your audience. A host says: "The hint above the fields sounds stiff, write it in my words." It needs the session, the webinar, the name of the line and the new value. An empty value deletes your wording and the campaign language shows again. Your wording is stored on the campaign and beats the translation, so it survives a language switch or a rebuild. An unknown name is refused with the list of valid ones. The labels of the form fields are a different thing and are changed with wi_change_registration_fields. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: standard line, my own words, hint above the fields, thank-you text

key.description: The label key, as the refusal or the settings list names it. Never guessed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

value.description: The host's own wording, or an empty string to remove the override.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_participant_label
title: Set one standard line of the participant pages
